title: Alpine Alltrades vs. Precision Paint Experts
description: Weighing Alpine Alltrades against Precision Paint Experts? Use this line-by-line checklist to read painting estimates and spot what a lump-sum bid leaves out.
h1: Alpine Alltrades vs. Precision Paint Experts
heroIntro: A practical walk through the line items a North Central Florida painting estimate should contain, so any two bids can be compared on the same terms.

keywords.primary: alpine alltrades vs precision paint experts
secondary: what should a painting estimate include
questions: What line items should a painting estimate include?
How do I compare a lump-sum painting bid with an itemized one?

sections.h2: Start with the paperwork, not the price
body: Alpine Alltrades is one of the painting and property-service companies homeowners around North Central Florida may be comparing. We cannot tell you what any other company includes in its quotes, and we would not try. What we can do is show you how to read an estimate, line by line, so that whatever bids you collect can be laid side by side honestly.

The total at the bottom of a quote only means something once you know what it buys. Two numbers that look far apart can describe nearly the same job, and two numbers that match can describe very different ones.

sections.h2: The line items worth looking for
body: Here is the checklist we suggest bringing to every estimate you receive, ours included:
bullets: Surfaces included and, just as important, surfaces excluded
Each prep step: washing, scraping, sanding, mildew treatment, caulking, spot-priming
Wood rot or fascia replacement, priced as its own item
Primer and topcoat named by manufacturer and product line
Number of coats for each surface
A start window and expected duration

sections.h2: How a Precision Paint Experts estimate is laid out
body: Our estimates are free and carry no obligation. A crew lead walks the property, measures, photographs conditions, and takes moisture readings where they are needed. The written quote then spells out the surfaces in and out of scope, the prep sequence, the primer and topcoat products by name, the coat count, and the schedule. Expect two full coats as a minimum, and a third where the color change is dramatic or the surface is porous.

Once you approve it, nothing is added later without written approval. If you want to see how we think about the exterior prep portion specifically, our exterior painting page walks through it, and our residential painting overview covers whole-home projects.

sections.h2: Why we do not publish prices
body: You will not find a price list on our site, because a fair number depends on the measured area, the condition of the surfaces and the prep they need, the product line, access and height, and how many colors are involved. A flat per-room figure would either overcharge a simple job or underquote a hard one. An itemized estimate for your property is the only honest number. Our post on how long exterior paint lasts in Florida also explains why prep and product choices drive long-term cost.

sections.h2: Request a bid you can compare
body: Walkthroughs are usually scheduled within 48 hours, and the itemized quote usually lands within one business day afterward. Lay it beside the others you collect and compare each line. If a bid leaves a line blank, ask the contractor to fill it in before you decide.

One more line is worth checking: who does the work. Precision Paint Experts uses its own crews and does not subcontract, and every crew member is covered by workers' comp. Ask each bidder the same question, and ask whether the people on site will be the people named in the contract. The answer belongs in writing alongside the price.

faqs.q: Is a lump-sum painting bid a red flag?
faqs.a: Not necessarily, but it is hard to compare. Ask the contractor to break out prep, products, coats, and exclusions so you can see what the total covers.

faqs.q: Does Precision Paint Experts work with Alpine Alltrades?
faqs.a: No. We are an independent, locally owned painting contractor. This page is a general guide to comparing bids.

faqs.q: How soon could my project start after I approve an estimate?
faqs.a: Most projects start one to three weeks after approval, and the schedule is written into the estimate.
